data.one_liner: A customizable search bar widget with a horizontal slide animation.
data.what_it_does: Provides a search bar widget that expands and collapses with a horizontal slide animation. It supports customizable styling, button icons, text input parameters, and various expansion callbacks.
use_when: You need an animated sliding search bar in your app bar or UI.
You want a customizable search input that collapses into an icon button.
avoid_when: You need a persistent, full-width search input without toggle animations.
You require a complex search-as-you-type delegate mechanism out of the box.
strengths: Provides built-in horizontal slide animation for search bars.
Highly customizable with multiple color, border, and widget options.
Includes keyboard focus control and expansion callbacks.
weaknesses: Limited to a specific sliding search bar pattern.
Relies on version 0.0.4 which may lack modern updates.
